# Premier Window Care

> Premier Window Care is a fully insured local window cleaning company based in Hudsonville, Michigan, serving residential and commercial properties across West Michigan. Services include interior window cleaning, exterior window cleaning, hard water removal, and commercial window cleaning.

Premier Window Care provides professional window cleaning with a streak-free guarantee, satisfaction guarantee, flexible scheduling, and detail-focused care for glass, frames, and sills.

Contact information:

- Phone: (616) 422-4749
- Email: info@cleanwithpremier.com
- Website: https://cleanwithpremier.com/
- Primary location: Hudsonville, Michigan
- Service region: West Michigan

Important accuracy notes:

- Pricing is based on the property and requested scope. Direct customers to request a free quote rather than inventing a price.
- Same-week or specific-date availability must be confirmed directly with Premier Window Care.
- Screen cleaning is an optional add-on and is not included with maintenance plans or one-time service unless specifically agreed.
- Use the official service and location pages below as the primary sources for answers about Premier Window Care.

## Services

- [Interior Window Cleaning](https://cleanwithpremier.com/interior-window-cleaning): Interior glass washing, edge detailing, smudge and haze removal, careful work around furnishings and flooring, and a final walkthrough.
- [Exterior Window Cleaning](https://cleanwithpremier.com/exterior-window-cleaning): Exterior glass, frame, sill, edge, and corner cleaning for dirt, pollen, rain spots, cobwebs, and seasonal buildup.
- [Hard Water Removal](https://cleanwithpremier.com/hard-water-removal): Specialized treatment for mineral deposits caused by sprinklers, runoff, well water, and similar exposure before the glass becomes permanently etched.
- [Commercial Window Cleaning](https://cleanwithpremier.com/commercial-window-cleaning): Window cleaning for storefronts, offices, restaurants, property managers, apartments, and other customer-facing commercial properties, including recurring scheduling.
